description: This file implements the main React component 'MindmapClient' for the mind map exploration page in a career navigation app. It manages view state, fetches graph and node details, handles user interactions, and provides UI elements including filters, node visualization, and role details panels.

methods.name: clamp
methods.description: Utility function to constrain a number within a specified min and max range.

methods.name: defaultFilters
methods.description: Returns the default filters configuration for the mind map view.

methods.name: defaultState
methods.description: Initial default state for the mind map view, including pan, zoom, selections, and filters.

methods.name: toSafeState
methods.description: Converts an arbitrary object into a validated MindmapViewState with fallback to defaults.

methods.name: safeErrorMessage
methods.description: Converts an unknown error into a user-readable error message string.

methods.name: getUserKey
methods.description: Generates or retrieves a stable user key for anonymous or authenticated users, stored in local storage.

methods.name: computeEmptyStateReason
methods.description: Determines the reason for an empty or error state in the graph visualization, used to inform UI messages.

methods.name: DebugRow
methods.description: React component to display a labeled row of debug information.
